stem: 金融情报机构（FIU）埃格蒙特集团的目标是为金融情报机构提供一个论坛，以实现以下目的：（选择三项。）

options.A: 在打击洗钱和恐怖主义融资的行动中安全地共享敏感信息
options.B: 营造促进各国相互信任的环境
options.C: 签署合作备忘录，承认并为具体问题的个案解决留出空间
options.D: 加强金融情报机构之间的全球合作
options.E: 提出打击金融犯罪的立法，包括反洗钱和反恐怖主义融资立法

stem_en: The goal of the Egmont Group of Financial Intelligence Units (FIUs) is to provide a forum for FIUs to: (Select Three.)

options_en.A: Securely share sensitive information in the fight against money laundering and the financing of terrorism
options_en.B: Establish an environment to foster trust among countries
options_en.C: Sign memoranda of cooperation that recognize and allow room for case-by-case solutions to specific problems
options_en.E: Propose legislation to combat financial crime, including money laundering and terrorist financing
